;International relations
*[[Afghan peace process]]
**[[Taliban]] leader [[Hibatullah Akhundzada]] says his group is "committed to a landmark deal with the U.S." despite carrying out hundreds of attacks against [[Afghan forces]] since February. Akhundzada also urged the U.S. "to not afford anyone the opportunity to obstruct, delay and ultimately derail this internationally recognised bilateral agreement". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/afghan-taliban-leader-committed-deal-200520084836131.html (Al Jazeera)]

;Law and crime
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bolivia]]
**Bolivian Minister of Health {{ill|Marcelo Navajas|es}} is dismissed and arrested in graft probe over ventilators bought in a Spanish company. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-05-20/bolivia-health-minister-arrested-in-graft-probe-over-ventilators (Bloomberg)]
*[[Crime in Arizona]], [[gun violence in the United States]]
**A gunman opens fire near the [[Westgate Entertainment District]] in [[Glendale, Arizona]]. Three people are injured, one of them seriously. The gunman is then taken into custody. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/phoenix-shooting-westgate-entertainment-district-glendale/ (CBS News)]
*In a hearing conducted over [[Zoom (software)|Zoom]], due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic]], a court in [[Singapore]] sentences a 37-year-old [[Malaysians|Malaysian]] man [[capital punishment in Singapore|to death]] for a 2011 [[heroin]] transaction. It is the first time that a death sentence has been imposed via teleconferencing in Singapore. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-singapore-crime/man-sentenced-to-death-in-singapore-on-zoom-call-idUSKBN22W0I6 (Reuters)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/05/malaysian-man-sentenced-death-singapore-zoom-call-200520044841246.html (Al Jazeera)]
*Missing [[WWE]] wrestler [[Shad Gaspard]]'s body is found on a [[California]] beach. [https://www.cnn.com/2020/05/20/entertainment/shad-gaspard-wwe-body-found-trnd/index.html (CNN)]
*U.S. authorities in [[Massachusetts]] arrest a father and son, aged 59 and 27, who have been charged in [[Japan]] with helping [[Carlos Ghosn]], former Chairman of [[Nissan]], to escape from Japan to [[Lebanon]] last year. [https://www.reuters.com/article/uk-nissan-ghosn/u-s-arrests-two-men-wanted-by-japan-over-ex-nissan-boss-carlos-ghosns-escape-idUSKBN22W20Z (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Burundian general election]]
**Citizens of [[Burundi]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Burundi|president]] and the members of the [[National Assembly (Burundi)|National Assembly]]. Following a campaign marred by violence, the election takes place amidst the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Burundi|COVID-19 pandemic]] and a [[social media]] [[Media blackout|blackout]]. Regional and international [[election observers]] have been blocked from monitoring the election, raising doubts about its fairness. [https://www.dw.com/en/burundians-vote-despite-coronavirus-outbreak/a-53479621 (DW)]
